sermon.title: Will Be Persecuted 01/20/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shows that Jesus foretold persecution before the end, and Acts confirms it: apostles jailed, Stephen stoned and the church scattered before Jerusalem fell. He warns against commune movements that misused “all things common,” calls for the unity of the faith, and points to Joel’s prophecy of a strong, united people.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Statements about named groups and leaders are kept as spoken and were not checked.

scriptures.text_nkjv: A day of darkness and gloominess, A day of clouds and thick darkness, Like the morning clouds spread over the mountains. A people come, great and strong, The like of whom has never been; Nor will there ever be any such after them, Even for many successive generations.

They run like mighty men, They climb the wall like men of war; Every one marches in formation, And they do not break ranks. They do not push one another; Every one marches in his own column. Though they lunge between the weapons, They are not cut down.

Let the priests, who minister to the LORD, Weep between the porch and the altar; Let them say, “Spare Your people, O LORD, And do not give Your heritage to reproach, That the nations should rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’ ”

faqs.question: When did the persecution of Christians begin, per him?
What does he say about Waco?
faqs.answer: The followers died because their leader was sexually intimate with women in the congregation.

faqs.question: What was “flirty fishing”?
faqs.answer: A Children of God practice he describes as using sex to evangelize.

faqs.question: What does he say about Hillsong?
faqs.answer: He says they allow drinking, which is not healthy.

faqs.question: How were Baptists persecuted?
faqs.answer: He says some were held under water until they died.

faqs.question: Where does the 10% go?
faqs.answer: To the building of the church and the word of God.

faqs.question: Who is the remnant in Joel?
faqs.answer: Those who stayed in the olive tree.
